_comment: AEP's vocabulary for the OpenChoreo SRE agent's handoff stage. The agent
supplies the mechanism — which answers get recorded — and this file supplies
OUR names for them. It ships to the agent the same way coding-agent-handoff/SKILL.md
does: rendered into a ConfigMap and mounted, with HANDOFF_PROVIDER_FILE
Incident identity is derived server-side, not accepted as forced tool
arguments: the dedupe key, the component, the project, the label set and
the adoption flag are not arguments a caller pins onto the create call.
Incident identity arrives as per-run headers instead, and AEP derives the
spell an argument therefore cannot get it wrong.
